rule: largest threshold whose false-match rate is at most 0.00001

dataset.name: Urban Civic Issues Image Dataset: Potholes and Garbage (QR4Change)

limits: Measured on Pune street photography, not on New York, and not on photographs of repairs.
A rotated or mirrored copy is not caught: this hash is not rotation invariant.
Nothing here tells whether the work was done. It tells whether the photograph is new.
